verdict.rationale: Channel3 is a product-data API, not an automation platform. Its only documented background capability is price-tracking subscriptions: once subscribed, it monitors a product and sends webhook notifications when the price changes, with no further user action. That is a narrow, single-purpose background monitor rather than general user-defined automations. Missing for 10: general-purpose configurable automations or scheduled jobs, triggers and actions beyond price-change alerts, detailed documentation of subscription setup and management, and independent or hands-on corroboration that background tracking works reliably.
